edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive a Base Salary of USD 450,000 per annum, payable in accordance with the usual payroll practices, together with standard employment benefits including medical, dental, and retirement plan participation.
3. SEVERANCE. On termination without cause, the Executive shall receive a Severance Amount equal to 12 months' base salary.

4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not directly or indirectly engage in or assist any business competing with Vireo Systems Inc. within the United States for a period of twelve (12) months immediately following the termination of employment. This scope and duration reflect standard market practice at this level, intended to protect legitimate business interests without imposing undue restraint.
